title: MCP++ StateRef@1
description: Normative wire shape for StateRef@1: a portable handle to shared state that MUST declare exactly one consistency mode. Missing mode, unknown mode strings, multi-mode arrays, and free-text modes are invalid. Allowed modes are exactly: immutable, single_authority, causal, crdt, consensus (ADR-0004 / plan KD-8). Normative prose: ipfs_accelerate_py/mcplusplus/docs/spec/state-ref.md.
$comment: Interface label: StateRef@1. Schema marker: mcp++/state/state-ref@1. Mode enum is closed and fail-closed; do not extend without a superseding ADR.

schema.description: Top-level schema marker for StateRef@1. MUST be this exact const.

id.description: Stable logical identity of this state handle. Distinct from root_cid (which may advance).

schema_cid.description: CID of the value-schema (or type descriptor) that root payloads under this ref MUST satisfy.

root_cid.description: CID of the current root value, snapshot, or document head. Null when the live value is not yet minted (e.g. empty single_authority keyspace). Absent is allowed; null means explicitly empty.

mode.description: Mandatory consistency mode. Exactly one of the five closed tokens. Missing or unknown values are invalid.

authority.description: Writer / ownership descriptor for this ref. Required in practice for single_authority and consensus; optional for immutable read-only refs.

version.description: Monotonic CAS / compare-and-swap version for the live value under this id. Used heavily by single_authority; MAY be present in other modes as an observational counter.

epoch.description: Claim / fencing epoch. Higher epoch supersedes lower under the mode's lease/fence rules (Profile G-compatible).

clocks.description: Causal / hybrid clock evidence for partial-order comparison. Primary for causal mode; optional elsewhere.

read_caps.description: Capability references authorizing read of this state (UCAN proof CIDs, ability tokens, or capability descriptors).

write_caps.description: Capability references authorizing write/update of this state under the declared mode.

lease.description: Exclusive-write lease bound to this ref (or null when no lease is held).

fence.description: Fencing token that invalidates stale writers after reclaim / epoch advance (or null when no fence is active).

merge_policy_cid.description: CID of the merge / reconciliation policy document. Required for crdt when merge rules are not fully determined by the CRDT document type; forbidden as a silent single_authority merge substitute.

retention_policy_cid.description: CID of the retention / compaction / archival policy for this state history.

confidentiality_policy_cid.description: CID of the confidentiality / disclosure policy (who may observe plaintext, ciphertext envelopes, retention of secrets).

consensus_policy_cid.description: CID of the consensus-plugin policy (membership, guarantee label, quorum, evidence format). Meaningful for mode=consensus; MUST NOT claim bft without a BFT engine.

parents.description: Causal parents: CIDs of prior StateRef snapshots and/or Event DAG nodes this ref observation depends on. Concurrent branches remain concurrent until the mode's reconciliation rule applies (never silent merge for single_authority).

provider.description: Optional provider / backend identifier (e.g. immutable-cid, sqlite-authority, automerge-crdt, consensus-plugin). Informational; mode remains authoritative.

metadata.description: Non-authoritative annotations. MUST NOT carry a second mode, authority override, or merge instruction that contradicts top-level fields.

cid.description: IPFS CID string. CIDv1 base32 (b…) preferred for new mints; CIDv0 (Qm…) remains readable when historical.

stateId.description: Non-empty logical state identity. Implementations MAY use UUIDs, DIDs, or content-addressed handles; the string form is opaque at this layer.

consistencyMode.description: Closed enum of MCP++ 1.0 state consistency modes (ADR-0004 §1; plan KD-8). No aliases. No additional values.

peerId.description: Transport peer identity (e.g. libp2p PeerID). MUST NOT be a DID string (use principal/DID fields for cryptographic identity). Transport identity is never execution authority by itself (plan KD-14).

principal.description: Issuer / holder principal: DID preferred; peer id or opaque authority key also accepted when profile-bound.

authority.description: Who is allowed to advance this state under the declared mode.

kind.description: Authority model class. none is typical for pure immutable refs with no live writer.

principal.description: Single authoritative principal when kind is principal or lease_holder.

principals.description: Member set when kind is quorum.

threshold.description: Quorum threshold when kind is quorum.

plugin_id.description: Consensus plugin identifier when kind is plugin.

guarantee.description: Honest consensus-class guarantee label when authority is consensus/plugin-backed (ADR-0004 §4).

consensusGuarantee.description: Four honest consensus-class labels (ADR-0004 §4 / KD-11). Profile G neighborhood agreement is coordination and/or majority_approval only — never bft.

capabilityRef.description: A read or write capability reference: either a proof/capability CID or an inline ability descriptor.

resource.description: Resource identifier (state id, CID prefix, or capability resource URI).

proof_cid.description: Optional UCAN / delegation proof bundle CID binding this capability.

lease.description: Exclusive-write lease. Stale writers after expiry or epoch reclaim MUST be rejected (fail closed).

holder.description: Principal that currently holds exclusive write under this lease.

expires_at_ms.description: Lease expiry (unix ms). Writers after this instant without renew MUST fail closed.

epoch.description: Lease epoch; MUST match or be consistent with top-level epoch when both are present.

renewable.description: Whether the holder may renew before expiry under the same epoch.

fence.description: Fencing token. Completions or writes presenting a lower token than the highest accepted token for this id MUST be rejected as stale.

token.description: Monotonic fencing token. Higher token wins; lower is stale.

epoch.description: Optional epoch bound to this fence.

issued_to.description: Principal the fence was issued to.

clocks.description: Clock set for causal comparison. At least one clock field SHOULD be present when mode is causal.

logical.description: Logical counter (Lamport-style) local to the producer.

merkle_frontier.description: Merkle / Event DAG frontier CIDs used as a partial-order clock.

vector.description: Sparse vector clock: principal id → counter.

observed_at.description: Wall-clock observation time (informational; not a total-order authority).
